## Problem and acceptance

Closes #

Explain the concrete problem and the behavior that satisfies the linked issue.

## Changes and decisions

Keep one purpose per commit. Describe alternatives only when they explain a tradeoff.

## Verification

Record the commands, environment, observed result, and limitations. Link current-revision CI and any relevant output. Separate fixtures from real-provider or customer results.

## Review and recovery

- [ ] The diff contains the intended changes without unrelated formatting.
- [ ] Current-revision CI passes and review findings are addressed.
- [ ] Review is identified accurately as AI, human, or both.
- [ ] Recovery refs and original assets are preserved; rollback is described.

Do not claim an independent human approval when only automated review took place.
